title: Oscillation Classes: An Interpolation Approach
summary: Let \(\varphi\) be an admissible concave function on \((0,1)\) and let \(X\) be a rearrangement-invariant space. We study the classes determined by the oscillation functional \[ \mathcal N_{\varphi,X}(f) = \left\| \frac{f^{**}-f^*}{\varphi} \right\|_X+\|f\|_1. \] We develop an interpolation method, based on the Aronszajn--Gagliardo extremal construction, which allows the normability problem and the determination of the optimal rearrangement-invariant Banach exterior to be treated in a unified way.
